title: Smoky Mexican Carnitas
description: Tender and flavorful pork carnitas, perfect for tacos or other Mexican dishes. Smoked with chipotle peppers for a deep, rich flavor.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the pork chunks and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chipotle peppers, lime juice, cilantro, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Shred the pork with two forks and serve with your favorite toppings, such as salsa, avocado, and sour cream.
